# Keyholder v0.2 — the ONLY allowed external dependencies (CONTRACT §1, §13.6 W19).
# Exactly two direct dependencies, pinned to versions actually installed
# in the local .venv (see docs/supply-chain.md).
# Transitive dependencies pulled in by these two (cffi,
# argon2-cffi-bindings, pycparser) are NOT listed here as direct
# dependencies; they are listed as transitive components in the SBOM
# generated by scripts/sbom.py, which caps the closure at 10 transitive
# / 12 total packages and fails on any change.
# Gates (mechanical, not policy-only — F16-D4/D7):
#   * scripts/sbom.py fails on any third direct dependency, on any
#     non-`==` pin, and on any registry redirection (extra index,
#     editable install, included file, non-PyPI index in a root pip
#     config). A new dependency needs a CONTRACT amendment FIRST and
#     then a record in docs/dependency-decisions/<name>.md in the same
#     change; the record alone never authorises it.
#   * scripts/sbom.py --diff sbom.json fails (exit 2) on any component
#     add/remove/version/licence change vs the committed SBOM, so a
#     dependency change cannot land silently in CI.
# Do not add a third direct dependency without a CONTRACT amendment
# and a dependency-decision record.
cryptography==50.0.2
argon2-cffi==25.1.0
